scenes.heading: AGENT-DESKTOP: AI USES YOUR PC NOW
scenes.say: Ever wanted an AI to click around your computer for you?

scenes.heading: ONE LINE TO INSTALL
scenes.say: It's called agent-desktop, and it's open source. Install it with one line: npm install -g agent-desktop.

scenes.heading: EVERY BUTTON GETS A REF
scenes.say: Then take a snapshot of an app. You get every button and field, each with a ref you can click.

scenes.heading: CLICK A REF, NOT A PIXEL
scenes.say: The agent clicks a ref, not a guessed spot on the screen.

scenes.heading: STALE REFS RETRY
scenes.say: If the screen changes, the old ref fails with a stale ref error. The agent just takes a new snapshot.

scenes.heading: NEED NODE.JS FIRST
scenes.say: The catch: you need Node.js and npm installed first.
Would you let an AI drive your desktop? Comment DESKTOP and I'll pin the link.

idea: agent-desktop lets an agent read and act on desktop apps through the OS accessibility tree.

claims.text: Install it with one npm command.
A snapshot lists every element the agent can act on, each with a ref.
The agent clicks a ref, not a guessed spot on the screen.
If the screen changes, an old ref returns STALE_REF and the agent takes a new snapshot.
